'''Knel'char I''' was one of three [[Star/Legends|stars]] that were located at the center of the [[Knel'char system]]. It served as a parent star to the stars [[Knel'char II]] and [[Knel'char III]], and by the time of the [[Republic Dark Age]] it was aging and decaying.
